name: Kromazone
summary: The Kromazone is the elite training area of the Terran Space Fleet Naval Academy. Here the best pilots in the fleet are put through their paces. If you want to become a starfighter pilot and perhaps fight against the Maranzar one day, you have to survive the Kromazone. Kromazone is a 3D game in which the action is viewed from the cockpit of a MantaRay fighter plane that automatically flies forward. In the first level, the task is simply to avoid flying balls. Only when this phase is completed will the fighter's blasters be activated and the enemy can be fired upon. The MantaRay can take a certain number of hits before it is destroyed. The remaining number is displayed at the bottom of the screen. The game can be played alternately by two players who can compete for a high score
